string.text: {=taom_messenger_target_unavailable}This person cannot be reached by messenger at this time.
{=taom_messenger_disabled}The messenger system is disabled in settings.
{=taom_messenger_already_sent}A messenger has already been dispatched to this person.
{=taom_messenger_hero_prisoner}{HERO_NAME} is imprisoned and cannot receive messengers.
{=taom_messenger_hero_fugitive}{HERO_NAME} is a fugitive and cannot be found.
{=taom_messenger_hero_child}{HERO_NAME} is too young to receive messengers.
{=taom_messenger_confused}The messenger seems confused — they were trying to reach someone in your own party!
{=taom_messenger_sent}A messenger has been dispatched to {HERO_NAME} and will arrive within {DAYS} days.
{=taom_messenger_arrived}A messenger from {HERO_NAME} has arrived. Do you wish to speak with them?
{=taom_messenger_lost}Your messenger to {HERO_NAME} was ambushed by bandits and never arrived.
{=taom_messenger_recipient_gone}Your messenger to {HERO_NAME} returned without delivering — the recipient is no longer reachable.
{=taom_messenger_dialog_init}I may need to send you a message later. Can I dispatch a messenger to you?
{=taom_messenger_dialog_npc_accept}Of course. I'll make sure to receive your messenger when they arrive.
